However, it fails the critical semantic requirement of 'printed branding/information' due to illegible gibberish text. While the form is correct, the function (conveying product info via text) is broken, lowering the alignment score significantly below a perfect 5.0. It is better than a complete mismatch (0.0) but worse than a fully conformant real packet.
